categories_thin: Pest control / exterminating: only two in-town entries surfaced and both are single-directory listings with no website found (Allied Termite & Pest Control, 91 Buckingham Ave; Terminator Exterminator Corp, 391 Summit Ave). A town-restricted map search returned South Amboy firms instead (E&G Exterminators, 122 N Broadway, South Amboy), so the category is thin but not empty - the earlier 'no operator in town' note was wrong.

Masonry / concrete: only one directory-only in-town listing (Mark Kral Masonry Contractor, 44 Lee Ave). Mario Grano & Sons markets masonry/concrete in the Perth Amboy area but its own site publishes no address, so it could not be placed in town. The category remains thin.

Hotels and motels: still no independent hotel or motel confirmed inside Perth Amboy. The two nearby independents found (Gallery Holiday Motel, 35 State St listing vs 2020 NJ-35; Amboy Motel, 4261 State Route 35) are in South Amboy according to the motel's own site and Yellow Pages.

Tutoring and test prep: only one independent local learning business (Little Bright Stars); everything else that surfaced (Kumon, Sylvan, Mathnasium, Genie Academy) is a brand or located outside town. Home Tutoring (766 Convery Blvd) and Aspiring Minds (538 Florida Grove Rd) appeared only on low-quality aggregators with no corroboration and were left out pending confirmation.

Dance, music and art schools: two entries only (Lascano Atelier, whose address is unresolved, and Bella Faith Dance Studio, directory-only). No independent music school with premises in town was found.

Towing, moving and storage, security installers: one towing entry (JJ Towing). Shipping/logistics is covered by MTI and Latino Shipping. Security-system installers produced only aggregator-level names (FBS Security Systems, Superior Security Services Corp at 494 Compton Ave) with no openable in-town listing, so none were added - genuinely unverified rather than confirmed empty.
Water damage restoration: reduced to two entries after the 313 State St lead-generation cluster was culled, so the apparent depth of this category in round 1 was an artefact.
caveats: Entries removed in this revision (do not re-add without new evidence): King Arthur Plumbing (69 New St is Woodbridge NJ 07095 per its own site), Red Trim Painting Services (Fords/Woodbridge per its own site and Edison Chamber listing), Iron Dome Roofing (own site shows Garwood NJ HQ), Trusted Roofing Repair Service, IronPeak Roofing Repair Services, Tree Removal Experts Perth Amboy and Swimming Pool Cleaning Perth Amboy (no trace in any source - phantom/keyword listings), Trinity Water Restoration and Elara Water Restoration (part of the 313 State St apartment-unit cluster), AD Buy's Junk Cars (multi-state junk-car lead generator, service-area pin), Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery (national furniture-delivery/3PL network, above the small-business ceiling), Freedom Aquatics (competitive swim squad hosted at the Raritan Bay YMCA, not a local contractor).

313 State St is ETC Tower, a residential/mixed-use apartment building with studio and one-bedroom flats plus some office space. Apartment-unit 'addresses' there are not commercial premises; only one of the three listings at that address (Quality Cooling & Heating) is retained, flagged low-confidence, and the two restoration listings there were dropped as a likely lead-generation cluster.

Group D private child care, preschool, tutoring, driving and art/dance instruction are RETAINED: the category brief explicitly lists 'childcare and preschools, tutoring and test prep, driving, dance, music and art schools', while the exclusion list covers only public schools. If the owner decides otherwise, the 11 child-care/instruction entries are Glenis Daycare, I Excel Child Care, Emmilys Daycare, All Stars Academy, Belonging Child Care Center, Vida Academy, Baby Bee Nursery, Butterfly Child Care, Little Bright Stars, St Mina Driving School and Lascano Atelier (plus Bella Faith Dance Studio, added this round).

Group membership is limited to C and D because that is the zone's assigned remit; group A (professional/office services) and group B (health and personal care) were not in scope for this zone and are not represented here.

Town membership was tested by comparing listings' map pins with the Perth Amboy municipal boundary, so businesses in South Amboy, Woodbridge, Fords, Keasbey and Hopelawn were excluded even when they appeared in 'Perth Amboy' searches. Borderline names ruled out this round: E&G Exterminators (South Amboy), Gallery Holiday Motel and Amboy Motel (South Amboy), Mark Kral's neighbours in the masonry results, Iron Dome Roofing (Garwood).

Several retained entries carry apartment or high suite numbers (e.g. 'Apt 1a', 'Apt 1e', 'Apt 2', 'Apt 4', '#2505', 'Unit 2037'), which usually means a home-based operator or a mailbox rather than a shopfront. They are kept because reviews or their own websites show trading activity, but premises should not be treated as commercial addresses.

National chains and franchises seen and deliberately excluded: Roto-Rooter, Rooter-Man, Maaco, Merry Maids, Rainbow Shops, Home Depot, AAMCO, and the YMCA-affiliated early learning centres. Public-sector and non-commercial entities excluded: Ignacio Cruz Early Childhood Center (public schools), Community Child Care Solutions (non-profit referral agency), American Legion post.

Entries whose only evidence is a single directory listing are marked as such in active_evidence (Allied Termite, Terminator Exterminator, Mark Kral Masonry, Bella Faith Dance Studio, and Quality Cooling & Heating). Several main directories (Yellow Pages, SuperPages, BBB, HomeAdvisor, Angi, GAF, chamberofcommerce.com) return HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so those were read only through search-result summaries.

The eastern waterfront (Harbor Terrace, Riverview/near the Raritan) is about 8-9 miles straight-line from central Milltown, so it is inside the 10-mile radius but at the edge; everything listed is inside that radius.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API is blocked from this environment and Yellow Pages, SuperPages, BBB, HomeAdvisor, Angi and GAF all return 403, so most active_evidence is map-listing or single-directory based rather than an independent second directory check.

Iron Dome Roofing LLC: GAF's roofer directory lists it at 158 Gordon St, Perth Amboy with (862) 329-4766, but the company's own site footer gives 300 South Ave, Suite 8 #1002, Garwood NJ 07027 and its contact page returned HTTP 404, so the Perth Amboy yard could not be confirmed and the entry was left out. Worth a phone check if the owner wants full coverage.

Google Maps returned non-town-specific results for pest control and masonry (the map view zoomed to the whole region), so those two categories rest on directory listings only; a fresh map pass logged in to a real Perth Amboy view would firm them up.

Riverview Companies dba Florence Landscaping: the NJNLA member record shows only a Perth Amboy PO Box, so the 72 Fayette St street address reported by the verifier could not be confirmed on an openable page.

New Jersey Tree Service LLC: address and review count come from a Birdeye profile and the phone from an NJ Board of Tree Expert directory entry; a search summary of that state directory showed the registration as suspended, which needs checking before outreach.

No headcount or revenue data was available for any business, so any borderline large operator is included with a note rather than dropped; Metropolitan Warehouse was the one clear above-ceiling case and was removed.

Tutoring candidates Home Tutoring (766 Convery Blvd) and Aspiring Minds (538 Florida Grove Rd) appeared only on low-quality aggregators; not added because neither could be corroborated on a second page.
